title: HiItsMatt.com
tagline: This site: a portfolio built as a stack of full-screen pages
summary: My portfolio. Three full-screen pages that hand over to each other rather than scroll, a shader hero whose gradient ends on a chevron punched out of the ink above it, and a case study page per project carrying its own media, write-up and metadata. A Hono API behind it holds the credentials and the caches, reading the live half of the site from GitHub and the curated half from a `.portfolio` folder committed inside each project's own repository, so a private repo can be shown without handing a token to the browser.
